description.en: Exact supplemental CPU source error variants, lifecycle and inspection return mappings; declaration presence is separate from execution and full catalog support.
description.ko: 보충 CPU 오류의 실제 항목, 수명 주기 및 검사 반환값을 기록하며 소스 선언의 존재를 실행 검증 및 전체 카탈로그 지원과 구분한다.

scope: Curated supplemental types plus discovered non-core Error/carrier declarations and the explicit CharError adapter; other core/prelude reference sections remain separate.

provenance.method: Lexical declaration and exact return-expression extraction from ordinary source and known generated Aevix payloads, not C++ diagnostic strings.
provenance.boundary: No source declaration count or inspection mapping implies every API is callable or exercised.
